title: Rav Acha of Parzikya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 59b according to the Rosh’s reading, and in Tosafot on Temurah 30b, s.v. Mana, asking Rav Ashi: “From where do we derive what the Rabbis said, that there is no harlotry for an animal?” The Gemara text Hyman uses reads Rava of Parkin.

notes.text: The supplied Gemara name is רבא מפרקין, Rava of Parkin. The William Davidson digital Yevamot 59b paragraph writes רבא מפרזקיא, Rava of Parzikya. These differing supplied and witness forms remain explicit; whether the supplied form matches Hyman’s printed page remains open.

Hyman’s printed entry (vol. I, p. 133) confirms Rava of Parkin (רבא מפרקין) as the Gemara reading he cites. The consulted Rosh on Yevamot 6:6 names Rav Acha מפרזקיה. Tosafot on Temurah 30b, s.v. Mana, uses the forms מפרזיקא and מפרזיקיא for Rav Acha. The Davidson Yevamot text gives Rava of Parzikya in Hebrew and Rava of Pirkin in English. These sources preserve distinct readings of the name.
